docs.description: Where to find the documentation inside the repository.

root.description: Directory (relative to the repository root) containing the docs. Use an empty string for the repository root.

index.description: Entry document, relative to the docs root. Rendered as the project's landing page.

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to the docs root) of files to download. Supports *, ** and {a,b}.

exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to the docs root) of files to skip.

url.description: Public origin of the site (no trailing slash).

basePath.description: Path prefix the site is served from, e.g. "/" or "/v2026/".

repository.description: Repository of this website (for "edit this page" links on local content).

defaults.description: Values applied to every project unless the project overrides them.

ref.description: Default branch, tag, or commit to download.

sections.description: Display names for documentation folders (first folder below the docs root). Unknown folders are title-cased.

label.description: Short name used in compact UI.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit to download.

nuget.description: NuGet package id; used for version and download stats.

logo.description: Path of the logo inside the repository; null to disable.

assets.description: Additional files (repository-relative globs) to download and publish under /assets/projects/<id>/.

localPath.description: Folder name of a local checkout below SITE_LOCAL_ROOT, if it differs from the repository name.

hidden.description: Download and build docs, but do not list the project.
